records.fn: trace.panel_slide (Coulomb mean over a panel) and trace.carter_slide (Carter creep), closed forms

tol.basis: closed forms without cancellation; = Gauss-Legendre 64 x 8 per piece (split at the window and the zero of sliding) to 1.9e-14 on 3000 panels incl. |B| 1e-16 ... 1e-12 |A| (oracle-fix probe8; v1 carter_slide erred 8.9e-2 there)

records.fn: trace.contact2d and trace.strip_report (frictionless 2-D contact of a piecewise-quadratic section; region maxima per piece)

c.basis: brent stops at 1e-14 (1 + |a| + |b|) on c, in mm: 10x absolute (v1 said rel 1e-12, tighter than its own stop at c 3.7 um)

pmax.basis: golden section per piece to 1e-14 in theta

fedge.basis: Gauss-Legendre 12 per piece between steps (same rule)

t_pmax.basis: location of a smooth maximum: sqrt of the value tolerance
